description: Establish a green baseline for backend and frontend so later changes can be verified. Confirm the .NET 10 SDK builds the API and that the frontend builds and lints cleanly BEFORE making any changes. This isolates pre-existing issues from ones introduced by this task.
steps: From repo root run the backend build with the .NET 10 SDK: /root/.dotnet10/dotnet build backend/src/JSO.Api/JSO.Api.csproj -c Release . Record whether it produces 0 warnings/0 errors (TreatWarningsAsErrors is enabled in backend/Directory.Build.props).
If restore is needed first, run /root/.dotnet10/dotnet restore backend/JSO.sln .
Install frontend deps: cd frontend && npm install (Node 22 is available).
Run frontend build: cd frontend && npm run build . Record result.
Run frontend lint: cd frontend && npm run lint (oxlint). Record result.
Write the baseline results (commands + pass/fail + any warnings) into this feature's findings field. Do NOT modify any source code in this feature.
acceptance_criteria: Backend build command has been run with /root/.dotnet10/dotnet and its exact result is recorded in findings.
Frontend npm run build and npm run lint have been run and their results recorded in findings.
No source files were modified during this feature.
